focus_areas: Integrity of eyespot (ocelli) geometry: ensure they are perfect circles/ovals without distortion.
Texture consistency: verify the 'hairy' texture of the thorax does not smear into the wing scales.
Edge definition: check the fringe (cilia) along the wing edges for natural irregularity vs AI-generated smoothness or noise.
Antennae structure: ensure the clubs are symmetrical and structurally sound.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'brush-like forelegs' checkpoint. The Router marked it untestable. Verify if high-resolution inspection reveals them tucked away (confirming biological accuracy) or if they are missing entirely (anatomical defect). Also, scrutinize the eyespots; AI often generates slightly warped or asymmetrical ocelli. Ensure the depth of field blur on the grass is optically consistent with a macro lens.
image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a green blade of grass. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a uniform brown color and a distinct row of black eyespots (ocelli) with white centers on both the forewing and hindwing. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and dark brown. The antennae are visible, showing a clubbed tip. The background is a soft-focus green vegetation.
